title: Finite-type reduced toric realizations and their smooth tori
statement: Let $M$ be a fine torsion-free monoscheme admitting a finite affine cover, and form $X=\mathbf Q[M]$ with its component tori and coactions as in [def-trf-monoscheme-toric-realization]. Then $X$ is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] and of finite type over $\mathbf Q$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. It has finitely many connected components, each integral. On each component the generic group $L$ is a finitely generated free abelian group of finite rank $r$, and $T=\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Q[L]$ is isomorphic as a group scheme to $\mathbf G_m^r=\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Q[t_1^{\pm1},\ldots,t_r^{\pm1}]$, with multiplication and unit given by multiplying coordinates and the coordinates $1$. In particular $T$ is a smooth finite-type $\mathbf Q$-group [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] acting on that component by the indicated coaction. For every reduced finite-type $\mathbf Q$-scheme $Y$, $T\times_{\mathbf Q}Y$ is reduced and of finite type, and its projection to $Y$ is smooth and surjective. The assertions about reducedness, finite type and finitely many components also hold for finite disjoint unions of such realizations.
